name: Wahasuchus
isnote: Described as an enigmatic mesoeucrocodylian, likely a neosuchian (English Wikipedia).
sum: Wahasuchus is an enigmatic mesoeucrocodylian, likely a neosuchian, from the Middle Campanian Quseir Formation of Egypt.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Mostly fragmentary remains from the Quseir Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Saber et al. 2018
